concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-classic-platforms-verification-process-check-verification-results]] — 2021-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Classic notification, Account API and Customer Area verification-result guide with per-check status, versioned payout-method type and conditional retry/document steps.
warnings: `FAILED` is final and sets the account holder to suspended in this Classic guide; `RETRY_LIMIT_REACHED` is only conditionally retriable by check type.
The company/nonprofit document escalation is conditional on specific `kycCheckCode` values and API version, not every INVALID_DATA result.
